description_en: Queries the status of the cross-account resource search feature by using the management account of a resource directory or a delegated administrator account of Resource Center
description_zh: 查询跨账号资源搜索开通状态
name: GetMultiAccountResourceCenterServiceStatus

InitialStatus.description_en:
The initialization status of the feature. Valid values:

Pending: The feature is being initialized.

Finished: The feature is initialized
InitialStatus.description_zh:
初始化状态。取值：

Pending：准备中。

Finished：就绪

ServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the feature. Valid values:

Enabled: The feature is enabled.

Disabled: The feature is disabled
ServiceStatus.description_zh:
服务状态。取值：

Enabled：已开通。

Disabled：已关闭
